provenance.instruction: In Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/, create a NEW dashboard. Add a visualization panel of type 'Stat' (not time series). Set the panel title to exactly 'fwgr-n1 Availability'. Set the panel's data source to the TestData data source (it may be listed as 'grafana-testdata-datasource' or 'TestData' - pick the test data source). Then save the dashboard with the title exactly 'fwgr-n1 Bench Dashboard'. Confirm the save succeeded (no unsaved-changes indicator). Report the dashboard's URL/UID after saving, and confirm the panel title and data source shown on the dashboard page.
